column1: # Lines Hover & Fly is flown along offline (flightsim --terrain; TerrainRuns.hpp, docs/design/flightsim.md).
# Drawn by flightsim --sample <region> 8 --length 160 --min-length 80 --seed 1 in each region of terrain_regions.tsv;
# lines picked by hand go at the end. Columns: name, region, x0, y0, x1, y1, z0 (start surface; empty: topmost), tags.
# Picked by hand: straight city-centre roads crossing flush joints between road meshes, 4 m clear of kerbs and anything
# raised either side (Drone slides). road_flat: one mesh across; road_stacked: two road
# surfaces stacked within 5 cm from 13 to 59 m; road_grade: the grade changing from 0.2 to 3.4% and back at the joints.
